verdict.rationale: Caveman ships its own skill, an agent and plugin support, so skill authoring is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack documents a template or guide for writing a new SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter. The community remark about the existing skill's verbose trigger description is about Caveman's own skill, not about authoring guidance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
